description: This Java source file defines a utility class ExternalEventHelper for managing and testing external event configurations within the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods for retrieving, deleting, and updating external events via REST API calls, as well as handling external event configuration updates. The class uses annotations from Lombok and testing assertions, indicating its role in testing or auxiliary functionality related to external events.

classes.description: A utility class providing methods to interact with external events and their configurations within Fineract for testing purposes.
